name: cadre-lifecycle-github
description: GitHub-flavored Agentic SDLC gate governance: lifecycle-review-github records lifecycle gate decisions from a real GitHub PR review via approve-from-github/approve-from-github-pr; link-source-issue-github records a real GitHub issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate via link-intent-from-github-issue/link-requirements-from-github-issue; report-gate-reviewers-github reports (read-only, never requests) which GitHub logins would be requested as PR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates via request-gate-reviewers; publish-gate-status-github posts (and idempotently updates) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary comment on a task's GitHub PR via publish-gate-status/list-gate-status. Requires cadre-lifecycle-core to also be installed. If you don't have a GitHub review to cite, cadre-lifecycle-core's generic lifecycle-review skill covers that case.

interface.shortDescription: Record Agentic SDLC gate decisions from a real GitHub PR review.
interface.longDescription: Conversationally record a lifecycle gate decision sourced from an actual GitHub pull request review, via approve-from-github/approve-from-github-pr, or record a real GitHub issue as the recorded source for a task's G1 (Intent) or G2 (Requirements Baseline) gate, via link-intent-from-github-issue/link-requirements-from-github-issue, or report (read-only, never requests) which GitHub logins would be requested as PR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates, via request-gate-reviewers, or post (and idempotently update) a one-way, read-only gate-status summary comment on a task's GitHub PR, via publish-gate-status/list-gate-status. Requires cadre-lifecycle-core.
defaultPrompt: Use lifecycle-review-github to record a gate decision from a GitHub PR review.
Use link-source-issue-github to record a GitHub issue as the source for a task's G1 or G2 gate.
Use report-gate-reviewers-github to see which GitHub logins would be requested as PR reviewers for a task's lifecycle gates (read-only, never requests).
Use publish-gate-status-github to post or refresh a one-way, read-only gate-status summary comment on this task's GitHub PR.
